**Feature:** `decide-code-version-rule` (`done` for the decision; M1 remains `in-progress`).

**Accountable owner:** `pipsystem` owns the design record; `stamp` owns rebuild selection.

**Historical recorder:** R. Andres Castaneda, Git author of the approval record.

## What and why

Automatically fingerprint each independently run calculation and its known result-affecting dependencies. Record exact source SHAs separately for provenance. Automatic fingerprints avoid missed manual label bumps without treating every package commit as a reason to rebuild every calculation. The decision did not select a general dependency scanner.

## Inputs and outputs

- **Inputs:** Calculation code and known helpers, rules and configuration that can affect its result; exact source SHAs for provenance. Planning needs the requested fingerprint and the fingerprint associated with the prior result.
- **Outputs:** A fingerprint per calculation and a separate source-SHA record. The target planner compares the requested fingerprint before execution. Hashing only when saving a result cannot select work before it runs.
